item.title: Azalea v0.4.3 - 2026-10-11
item.description:
Homegrown. Over 800 island items, no wipe. Full notes at azaleamap.com/changelog
### Added - Over 800 island items: clothes, food, drinks, tools, medical and ammo boxes with local brands and Portuguese names - Island infected: fishermen, bombeiros, police, farmers, a festa crowd and the confraria - In-game bug report on the escape menu - Head protection against ash and heat in graded tiers - Sondagem fence hum, audible from about 25 m
### Changed - About 7 in 10 items with an island version now spawn as the island one - Vanilla police and paramedic clothing and infected replaced by island versions - Food spawns in town buildings near the airfield - Pioneer can spawn in military loot - Helipad reward rifles come assembled with spare mags - Night vision in kits comes on its headstrap - Landing kits carry a variometer instead of a GPS - Eruptions about 4.5 hours apart instead of 3 - Infected and animals die at the Sondagem fence - Smaller item textures, faster download
### Fixed - Glider hotkey server crash - Glider camp server crash - Changing gear while gliding - Eruption lost on server restart, it now resumes - Surge damage now follows the visible cloud - Surge sound now travels with the cloud - Other players' eruption screen effects showing on your screen - Shock vision flashing yellow during an eruption - Eruption blur over the inventory and map - Sondagem fence shocking knocked-out players - Sonar helmet and vehicles protect at the fence again - Players locked in a shipping container after a restart - Logging in underwater dragged you to the lakebed - Glider not deploying after a vault or climb - Head dipping into the terrain on stalled glider landings - Helicopter event stutter for high-ping players - Glider kit keys opened nothing - Garbled symbols in item descriptions

item.title: Azalea v0.4.0 - 2026-08-29
item.description:
Signal. Warning: flashing lights during the eruption. Full notes at azaleamap.com/changelog
### Added - Volcanic eruption event - Pyroclastic surge - Ashfall damage - Lava - Volcanic lightning - Eruption visual effects - Eruption music - Lava ambient audio - Radio and PA emergency broadcasts - The Signal, a recurring transmission on powered radios - Helicopter event - Hang glider (EXPERIMENTAL), 2 variants - Hang glider wreck dynamic event - Cloud Forest biome - Lagoa Verde - Cedro performance pass - Airfield performance pass - Additional POI performance passes
### Fixed - Rocks on the beach were floating above the sand - Trees in the Fogo area were floating above the ground - A castle wall clipped through the gas station pump island - A stray sidewalk sat out in the wilderness - Prison island satmap and mask were incorrect - Feedshacks and hunting stands collided with generated forest - Wind turbines were not functional

item.title: Azalea v0.3.5 - 2026-02-01
item.description:
Live Alpha. Azalea moved away from scheduled playtests to something closer to live-service alpha: the island stays up, and updates ship as they are ready.
### Added - Custom earplugs: press N to toggle, arrow keys to cycle volume levels - Combinable items: bandages, rags and other stackables - New clothing: Chernarus Military Sweater, Grey Gulag Jacket, Traditional Hunting Boots - New crafting: Bear Headdresses, worms for fishing bait - Green and TTsKO Attack 2 Bags in high-tier and contaminated zones - Seasonal spooky infected, active automatically during Halloween
### Changed - Prison Island ship made permanently toxic, gas mask required - Cedro performance pass - Ambulance wrecks corrected to carry only medical, food and clothing - C130 crash site loot corrected - Helicopter crash site count reduced - Airfield weapon tiers rebalanced - Contaminated Area: FAL and AugShort buffed - Sonar Restricted Area: Kazuar Optic made findable - Underground Bunker weapon spawns increased - Police car spawns reduced to intended levels - Night vision goggles rebalanced - Day/night cycle: 3-hour days, 30-minute nights - General performance optimization pass
### Fixed - Several invisible exploit gaps closed with walls - Tire and spare wheel spawns on vehicle wrecks were not spawning - AK101 was not spawning properly - Two offroad vehicle types were not spawning correctly

item.title: Azalea v0.3.4 - 2025-09-23
item.description:
Grounded. Not a flashy update, but the map getting serious: stability, polish, and a lot of accumulated fixes.
### Added - New static plane crash sites across the island - Wells restored at camps and settlements - New Azalea loading screens - Discord, Twitch and Ko-fi buttons in the main menu
### Changed - Weather balance adjusted, less excessive rain - Player spawn points reworked - Loot tiers adjusted for better progression - Sonar pillars and panels reworked
### Fixed - Water tile gaps near airfields - Sonar pylons stayed lit after shutdown - Infected in dynamic events got stuck - Firestation exploit gap closed - Livonia tower and bunker exit placement corrected - Lorry rear wheels clipped into terrain

item.title: Azalea v0.3.0 - 2024-10-02
item.description:
Expansion. The island went from a handful of POIs to a full-scale world.
### Added - 24 new locations: cities, military bases, villages, ruins and camps - Fresh 4-tier loot economy - Cave tunnels across the map - Directional signs - Shipwrecks and a crashed AC-130
### Changed - Full forest rework across the island - Highlands reworked - Central lake recolored to tropical blue - Roads smoothed and hiking paths fixed

item.title: Azalea v0.0.1 - 2023-12-01
item.description:
First Light. The first time anyone stepped foot on Azalea.
### Added - Azalea cargo trucks, 4 variants - Azalea Bridge, modelled after the real bridge - Reworked Echo Fortress and the Hotel POI - Custom main menu with DMCA-free music - Loot system reworked with a tiered structure
### Changed - More cows, roosters and crocodiles
